sources.title: Environmental Photographer of the Year 2025 - programme page (official, CIWEM)

prize.text: GBP 1,000 for the overall title plus GBP 500 for each of the four category winners (about GBP 3,000 in cash total). The ledger's claim of a GBP 5,000 overall prize and GBP 1,000 per category is not what the 2025 official programme publishes.
prize.quote: Environmental Photographer of the Year (£1,000 cash prize) ... From source to sea - working at different scales (£500 cash prize) ... Inspired by nature (£500 cash prize) ... Deluge or drought (£500 cash prize) ... Models of stewardship (£500 cash prize)

freeEntry.text: Free to enter for professionals and amateurs worldwide, no fee stated anywhere in the rules.
freeEntry.quote: The competition is free to enter for professional and amateur photographers of all ages, from all over the world.

deadline.text: 2025 edition closed 28 September 2025, 18:59 BST (the programme page shows 'The deadline has passed September 28, 2025'). No 2026 dates published at the time of checking.
deadline.quote: The deadline has passed September 28, 2025 at 6:59 AM ... Submit before the deadline of 23:59 BST on Sunday 28 September.

eligibility.text: Open worldwide, all ages and experience levels; photo must be taken on or after 1 January 2023; entrant must own the copyright; no children under 18 in the frame.
eligibility.quote: Your photograph must be taken on or after 1 January 2023. ... You must be the sole author and owner of the copyright ... You may not include children or young people under the age of 18 in your photo.

aiPolicy.text: AI-generated or AI-edited imagery is banned.
aiPolicy.quote: You may not make any use of artificial intelligence (AI) to create or edit a photo.

summary: Free-to-enter UN-backed environmental photography prize, but the 2025 edition closed on 28 September 2025 and the official cash is far smaller than the ledger claims: GBP 1,000 overall plus GBP 500 per category, not GBP 5,000 plus GBP 1,000 per category.
flags: Prize amount in the source ledger (GBP 5,000 overall, GBP 1,000 per category) is contradicted by the official 2025 programme page (GBP 1,000 overall, GBP 500 per category).
2025 edition is closed; no 2026 dates published yet, so the listing is not actionable today.
attribution: Verified by session arena-f10345ed against the official CIWEM/EPOTY pages on 2026-11-01.
